Title: Azure spot virtual machine meter changes

Body.Content:
Low-priority virtual machines (VMs) on scale sets are being replaced by Azure spot VMs and will be retired on February 3, 2020. As a result,the resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) and names of Azure low-priority virtual machines on scale sets will change on that date.

See this table for details.
